name: Energy Absolute Public Company Limited
summary: Energy Absolute Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of crude palm oil, biodiesel, and glycerol products in Thailand. It operates through five segments: Manufacturing and distributing crude palm oil, biodiesel products, and pure glycerin products; Manufacturing and distributing electricity from solar and wind power and biomass; Manufacturing and distributing electric vehicles; Manufacturing and distributing batteryl; and Others. The company provides phase change materials, as well as electric bus, car, and ferry.
